reason: Lookalike plan L2b (the E1 r2c GC finding's cause): the Storage panel's lookalike report (web/workspace/api.ts lookalikeGroups) reads the entries' byNfc index by values in fixed pages, each full page's trailing group by count() and a value cursor advanced past its rows in hand, instead of a key cursor whose per-row key strings cost the page a ~100 ms collection; plus its test-only hook (inert unless a test page sets it). api.ts is bundled into the CLI, so cli/pyjs.cjs grows by the new walk and the hook.
